Kit summary

Lightning AttackBasic
Deals 240% ATK [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy and inflicts 1 layer of [Electric Shock] on the target for 3 turns, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Sweeping ThunderActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 4 stages of 150% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy and each stage also removes 1 layer of buffs (excluding Attribute Buffs) from the target. Afterward, for every 2 layers of [Electric Shock] owned by the target, there is a 100% chance of converting them into 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. The conversion stops when [Bleed] layers owned by the target reach the limit or when the target has fewer than 2 layers of [Electric Shock].
Thunderstrike Longspear Lv.1When Lance casts active skills, grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns first. At the end of Sweeping Thunder, also deals 200% ATK DMG (considered as [Bleed] DMG and for every 1 layer of [Electric Shock] owned by the target, additionally increases Lance's ATK DMG by 75%) to the target and reduces their Turn Meter by 60% (for every 1 layer of [Bleed] owned by the target, additionally reduces their Turn Meter by 4%).
Thunder PowerPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Each time an enemy with max layers of [Bleed] is inflicted with 1 layer of [Bleed], there is a 100% fixed chance to inflict 1 layer of [Electric Shock] on the enemy for 3 turns. For every 20 layers of [Electric Shock] inflicted by Lance, he gains [Cover Tracks] for 2 turns, during which he is immune to control effects. If Lance receives control effects while owning [Cover Tracks], the effects of Booming Thunder will be triggered: increases Lance's Turn Meter by 35% and inflicts 2 layers of [Electric Shock] on all enemies for 3 turns; this effect can only be triggered once every 2 turns.
Thunderstrike Longspear Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Lance gains [Cover Tracks] for 1 turn and 2 layers of [Lightning Spear]. The effects of Booming Thunder are considered as triggered when Lance gains [Cover Tracks] again while having [Stealth]. When [Bleed] on the enemy is cleansed, if Lance has [Lightning Spear] at the moment, consumes 1 layer of [Lightning Spear] to pursue and attack the enemy for once immediately.
Violent ThunderstormActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Gains [Cover Tracks] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 6 stages of DMG to enemies, each of which deals 260% ATK [Bleed] DMG to a random single enemy and also inflicts 1 layer of [Electric Shock] for 3 turns, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Afterward, Lance gains 6 layers of [Lightning Spear] (up to 6 layers). At the end of any unit's turns, Lance consumes 1 layer of [Lightning Spear] to pursue and attack a random enemy for once, dealing 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG and inflicting 1 layer of [Electric Shock] for 3 turns.
Thunderstrike Longspear Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Lance gains [Cover Tracks] for 1 turn and 2 layers of [Lightning Spear]. The effects of Booming Thunder are considered as triggered when Lance gains [Cover Tracks] again while having [Stealth]. When [Bleed] on the enemy is cleansed, if Lance has [Lightning Spear] at the moment, consumes 1 layer of [Lightning Spear] to pursue and attack the enemy for once immediately.
Thunderstrike Longspear Lv.3Increases [Lightning Spear] obtained by casting Violent Thunderstorm to 10 layers (up to 10 layers). Enhances the pursue-and-attack effect when consuming [Lightning Spear]: Pursues and attacks the enemy who has dealt the highest DMG, removes 1 layer of buffs (excluding Attribute Buffs) from the target first, then deals [Bleed] DMG equal to 220% of Lance's ATK and inflicts 1 layer of [Electric Shock] on the target for 3 turns.
